Careers at The Proud Paintbrush – Fort Bend & Houston Areas

Looking for painting jobs in Sugar Land, Missouri City, Richmond, Rosenberg, Katy, Fulshear, Southwest Houston, or West Houston?
We’re hiring motivated painters and team members who care about quality, craftsmanship, and community. Here’s everything you need to know about joining The Proud Paintbrush.

Quick Answer

Q: How do I apply for painting jobs with The Proud Paintbrush in Fort Bend & Houston?
A: Fill out the short form below or email us your resume. We’re looking for skilled painters, apprentices, and crew leads who want to grow their careers with a company that values quality, teamwork, and community.

Why Join The Proud Paintbrush?

Working here isn’t just a job – it’s an opportunity to be part of a high-quality, community-focused painting company. We:

  • Offer competitive pay and steady work year-round

  • Train you in industry-leading painting techniques

  • Encourage growth into crew lead or project manager roles

  • Support our community through our Paint It Forward program

Current Open Positions

1. Residential Painter – All Areas
Deliver high-quality interior and exterior painting. Experience preferred but not required. Full-time role.

2. Painting Apprentice
Start your painting career and learn from our experienced team while earning a steady income.

3. Crew Lead / Foreman
Manage projects, lead a team, and uphold our high standards of craftsmanship.

See What It’s Like to Work With Us

Our Hiring Process

  1. Submit your application or resume

  2. Quick phone interview

  3. Skills assessment (for painters)

  4. Final in-person interview

Our Culture

At The Proud Paintbrush, we:

  • Take pride in craftsmanship

  • Value integrity and communication

  • Build strong relationships with clients and team members

  • Believe in a positive, growth-oriented workplace

Our crews work primarily in Sugar Land, Missouri City, Richmond, Rosenberg, Katy, Fulshear, Southwest Houston, and West Houston, so you’ll be part of a close-knit, local team.

How to Apply

Ready to build a career, not just a job?
Fill out the form below or email your resume, and start your journey with The Proud Paintbrush today.

Apply Right Here!

Join a team who takes pride in the work they do.

Founded by Chris Petkau with 20+ years in the construction industry
